client_telemetry_contract.why_not_implemented: An ingestion endpoint would add an /api/v1 route (OpenAPI 307/358 and the route inventory are frozen in UI-17) or require a third-party SDK and credentials that do not exist. Both need separate authorization.
client_telemetry_contract.sampling: ≤10% page views; 100% of errors with per-session rate limit
client_telemetry_contract.retention: ≤30 days, aggregated thereafter; honour the published privacy policies (docs/legal/privacy_policy/*)
